title: Result status envelope
description: The common status vocabulary every gate and validator returns (runtime/lib/result.mjs, PAR-RESULT-SEMANTICS, condition P3). Regression guard for TEMPLATE v2.0.5's B08/B09/B10: NOT_RUN and NOT_APPLICABLE are valid only in reports, never as a gate's own terminal status; PASS_WITH_WARNINGS never renders as bare 'PASS'.
